data.action: 泡浴时举着平板查看数据
data.description: 研讨会办公室深处的私人浴室里，莉音把黑发挽起，泡在温水中，单手举着防水平板，屏幕上滚动着明天的预算数据。红瞳在蒸汽中依然锐利，她轻轻推了推滑落的眼镜——「……预算案还剩最后一页。泡完这十分钟，就把它改完。」
data.lighting: cool tablet glow, warm dim bath light, gentle steam haze
data.promptProse: Rio sits in the bath with her hair pinned up, waterproof tablet in one hand, the other adjusting her glasses; cool screen light meets warm bathroom light through steam.
data.title: 调月莉音 · 研讨会深夜的数据浴
data.animaCaption: One hand holds the waterproof tablet while the other adjusts her glasses above the bath.
